title: Compact maximum-influence bound
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ have positive variance, and let $0<\delta<1$. Write $I$ for its total influence, $V$ for its variance, and $\rho=(1-\delta)/(1+\delta)$. Then $\left(\rho^{I/V-1}/(I/V)\right)^{1/\delta}\le \max_i\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)$, with variance and coordinate influences computed under the uniform sign-cube distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to $\{−1,1\}$
